consult.title: BridgeConsult
consult.subtitle: Your Web3 security assistant
consult.name: BridgeSecur
consult.mode: Templated answers (no AI model connected). Every answer uses only this session's check data or general guidance.
consult.contextNone: No destination checked yet. I can still explain general safety topics.
consult.noFindings: No hits on any source we checked.
consult.scoreNote: Risk signal score, not a safety guarantee
consult.proceedNote: Only proceed if you fully understand the risk and trust this address.
consult.whyBody1: Only known threat lists (T1: sanctions and scam databases) can produce Critical.
consult.whyBody2: Graph, behaviour and contract signals can raise a Warning. Community reports alone are capped at Warning to prevent report spam.
consult.whyBody3: The AI only explains the evidence. It never decides the verdict, and it never says an address is safe.
consult.ask: Ask me anything about this transaction…

quick.verify: How do I verify the recipient?
quick.limits: What are the limits of this result?
quick.wrongSend: What if I send to the wrong address?

consult.noEvidence: I can't verify that from this check's evidence, so I won't guess.
consult.noCheck: There is no check in this session yet, so I have no evidence about any address. Run a check on the Send screen first.
consult.a_why_none: I didn't find risk signals in the sources I checked. That is not a guarantee: new scam addresses appear every day.
consult.a_why: These are the signals behind the verdict:
consult.a_explain_none: No source returned a finding for this address.
consult.a_continue: If you continue, your wallet will ask you to confirm. Blockchain transfers cannot be reversed, and BridgeSecur cannot recover funds. The decision is yours.
consult.a_verify: Confirm the full address with the recipient through a different channel (call, in person). Compare every character, not just the start and end. Consider sending a small test amount first.
consult.a_poisoning: Address poisoning: a scammer sends you a tiny transfer from an address that starts and ends like one you use, hoping you copy it from your history later. Always compare the full address.
consult.a_tiers: Sources not checked this time: {{tiers}}. Treat the result as incomplete.
consult.nkrIntro: I looked at the latest result. No known risk signals were found in the sources that were checked successfully. I still cannot guarantee the destination is safe.
consult.a_whyNone: No risk was found because these sources returned no match for this address:
consult.a_whyNone_zero: No source returned a confirmed 'no match' in this check, so I cannot explain why no risk was found.
consult.a_sources_demo: These results are DEMO fixtures, not live intelligence.
consult.a_limits: Limits: 'no known risk' only means the sources that ran did not flag this address. New or unlisted scams are not covered, a source that was not checked or unavailable says nothing, and the result can change over time.
consult.a_checkMore: Before confirming: confirm the full address with the recipient through a separate channel, compare the first and last characters, check the network matches what they expect, and consider a small test transfer first.
consult.a_wrongSend: Blockchain transfers cannot be reversed. If you send to the wrong address, neither BridgeSecur nor the network can recover it; only the recipient could return it voluntarily.

learn.title: Fraud Learning Center
learn.body: Common scams: address poisoning (look-alike addresses in your history), fake airdrops that ask you to sign approvals, impersonated support agents, and phishing sites that copy wallet pages. Rule of thumb: never share your seed phrase, compare the full address, and test with a small amount.

about.title: About Us
about.body: BridgeSecur checks a destination wallet before you send and explains the risk with evidence. We warn, never block, and never hold funds.

partnerships.title: Partnerships
partnerships.body: Wallets, exchanges and threat-intelligence providers can integrate the check API. This page is a placeholder for the hackathon demo.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: We send only the chain id and the destination address to the check service. We never send your address or the amount. Checks and transfers live in your browser memory for this session only. Theme and language are stored on your device.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body: BridgeSecur provides risk signals, not guarantees. You decide and send from your own wallet. Demo fixtures are not live threat intelligence.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: For the hackathon demo, reach the team through the event channel. A public contact address will be added before launch.

api.title: API
api.body: POST /v1/check with { chain_id, destination } returns a verdict, evidence and tier statuses. Documentation will be published with the backend.

help.title: Help Center
help.body: Paste a destination on the Send screen. Read the verdict and the evidence. If a warning appears, verify the recipient through another channel before you continue.
